data: Use the prepared UD r2.15 Arabic-PADT and English-EWT train/dev/test files in data/multilingual_sources.json. Verify all six processed text hashes before model scoring. Build disjoint-role partitions from the existing split files using the project's 65-byte complete chunks (64 transitions each). Candidate updates and warmup use only train, probe only dev, and held-out scoring only test.
evaluation_sample: For each language separately choose 64 dev indices without replacement with numpy.default_rng(6301).choice, sort ascending. Do the same independently for 256 test indices with seed 6302. Fix these samples across model seeds and policies. Record selected indices and SHA-256 of inputs. No tuning on the selected target.
schedule: For each language and model seed initialize the byte Transformer with torch.manual_seed(seed) and AdamW. Using numpy.default_rng(seed) draw 32 warmup batches of four train chunks with replacement, then draw a (16,4) matrix of train candidates, then 16 uniform choice indices in [0,4).
comparison: Reuse the stage-62 one-step decision/evaluation code. At each state along the reuse4 trajectory calculate fresh and cached policy results using the same parent model/optimizer and four candidates. Evaluate both branches after one update on the same target sample and continue only the reuse4 branch. Keep the target out of selection. Refresh at steps 0,4,8,12.
primary: Mean immediate target loss after reuse4 minus loss after fresh on Arabic stale steps (ages 1,2,3). Include ties. Average 12 differences per seed and weight eight seed means equally. Positive favors fresh. Use natural-log loss per byte transition.
descriptive: English same contrast. Report signed and absolute magnitudes, lower/higher/equal counts, changed-choice-only summaries, and variation by model seed and gradient age per language. Conditional means with no changed choice are null. Compare signs with stage 62 descriptively. No pooled contrast, significance test or confidence interval.
checks: 256 pairs, 512 branch evaluations, 64 age-zero controls, 96 stale decisions per language. Require matching model and optimizer states and losses when both select the same candidate, replayable schedule, cache-only trajectory continuity, finite losses and complete coverage. Save raw measurements, code and source hashes, environment and audit. No adaptive reruns or exclusions.
scope: Source and seeds differ from stage 62; these PADT/EWT corpora were previously used by this project and stage 45 exposed their test splits. This is a prospectively specified transfer diagnostic with one fixed dev and test sample per language. It measures immediate branch loss, not training speed or aggregate long-horizon utility.
